Subject: POC plan & model selection — Acme Corp

Hi Sarah / Diego,

Thanks again for the demo call this morning — great context on the support workflows and multilingual needs. Below is the proposed POC plan so we can get alignment and schedule a kickoff. High level goals, evaluation plan, timeline, and owners are included.

POC objective
- Validate Redwood can meet latency, accuracy, and multilingual requirements for Acme's customer support routing and intent extraction.

Success criteria (proposed)
- Intent classification accuracy >= 90% on Acme's eval set
- Entity extraction (NER) F1 >= 0.88
- 95th percentile end-to-end latency < 300ms for English requests (mobile/low payload)
- Reasonable performance (relative baseline) for Spanish and Portuguese test slices

Evaluation plan
- You provide a blinded eval set (up to 2k examples) with labels and language tag; Redwood will run inference and return metrics and confusion matrices.
- We'll run three model variants (primary, quantized primary, fallback) and produce a short MOP (method of procedure) with scoring and sample outputs.

Model selection (initial recommendation)
- Primary: Llama-3-8B (quantized to 4-bit for cost/throughput) — best balance of quality/cost for intent+NER in our experience
- Fallback: Llama-2-Chat-7B (8-bit) — lower-cost fallback for routing during load or degraded conditions
- Multilingual supplement: if we see gaps on Portuguese, use an additional run with XGLM-7B for comparison on PT/FR slices

Timeline (3-week POC)
- Week 0 (kickoff): finalize MSA/MoU, get eval set + sample traffic, set up access
- Week 1 (integration): integration + sample inference + initial metric run
- Week 2 (tuning): apply quantization/profile variants and run full eval; iterate on prompts/config
- Week 3 (wrap): final metrics, go/no-go decision, provide recommended production config and cost estimate

Ownership
- Redwood sales owner: Rishi Malhotra (me) — overall POC coordination and commercial
- Redwood SE: Marissa Cole — integration, prompts, eval harness
- Redwood infra/ops: Ben Carter — trial capacity, routing/fallback policies
- Security/Compliance: Laura Bennett — SOC2 evidence and data handling notes

Next steps
1) Please confirm the success criteria and languages we should prioritize (English, Spanish, Portuguese — confirm if French should be included)
2) Sign the attached MOP/POC scope (acme-poc-mop-v1.pdf) and SOC2 summary if needed
3) Proposed kickoff window: next Tue/Wed morning PT — I'll send a calendar invite once we confirm

Attachments: acme-poc-mop-v1.pdf, redwood-soc2-summary.pdf

Thanks — happy to adjust.

Regards,

Thanks Rishi — this looks good and aligns with what we discussed. A few clarifications/questions:

- Languages: please include Portuguese for sure; we also have a small French support group — can we include a short FR slice (maybe 200 examples) in the eval?
- Fallback behavior: how will the system route to fallback model? We want a predictable policy (latency threshold OR confidence score) and an estimate of added cost when fallback is used 10% of the time.
- Cost: can you provide rough token / inference cost estimates for the primary vs fallback (quantized vs non-quantized)? Even ballpark numbers will help our procurement team.

We can confirm kickoff on Tue Apr 21 10am PT — that works for Diego and me. Please send calendar invite.

Quick asks

- Ben: evaluate trial capacity options — dedicated small pool vs hosted burst. Implement routing policy prototype: route to primary by default, route to fallback when confidence < threshold or latency > 350ms. Provide rough cost delta if fallback hits 10% of requests.
- Laura: can you surface the SOC2 summary and any additional data handling notes the customer might ask for? (attached redwood-soc2-summary.pdf)

Model variants I'm proposing for the runs (start with these; we can swap if we see large language gaps):
- Primary candidate: Llama-3-8B (quantized 4-bit variant for throughput)
- Fallback: Llama-2-Chat-7B (8-bit)
- Multilingual comparison run: XGLM-7B (specifically for Portuguese/French slices)

Please reply with ETA for each deliverable and any blockers. I'll confirm kickoff invite to Acme once we have calendar time confirmed.

Thanks,
Rishi
